lang_menu_body: Sicela ukhethe ulimi oluthandayo. I-Dayli AI izokhuluma nawe ngalolo limi:
lang_switched_confirm:
Ulimi luhlelwe lwaba isiZulu 🌸

Ngingakusiza kanjani wena nomndeni wakho namuhla?
consent_body:
Sawubona! Ngingu-Dayli — umsizi wakho wezempilo wakho nomndeni wakho, obheka nesimo sezulu nokushisa lapho ukhona.

Ngaphambi kokuba siqale: ukuze ngikunikeze iseluleko esifanele, ngidinga ukukhumbula kancane ngawe — engimsizayo nalapho ukhona.

• Imininingwane yakho iyimfihlo futhi ayithengiswa neze
• Ungathumela igama elithi *stop* noma *opt out* nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ukususa yonke into masinyane
• Angisiye udokotela, futhi angihloli izifo zokugcina

Ingabe ukulungele ukuqala?
consent_footer: Esimeni esiphuthumayo shayela usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo
consent_terms_body:
Nansi indlela i-Dayli evikela ngayo idatha yakho:

• *Ukugcinwa:* Kuvikelekile futhi akuxhunyanisiwe negama lakho langempela
• *Ukwabelana:* Akwabelwa abanye noma abakhangisi
• *Ukususa:* Thumela *STOP* noma nini ukususa unomphela idatha yakho
• *Inhloso:* Isiqondiso sezempilo, isimo sezulu nezibhedlela eziseduze

Ingabe ukulungele ukuqhubeka?
consent_declined_body:
Ngiyaqonda kahle. Isinqumo sakho sihloniphekile futhi ayikho idatha egciniwe.

Ungabuza imibuzo evamile noma nini. Ukuze uqale kabusha, thumela *START*.

_Esimeni esiphuthumayo sezempilo, xhumana ngokushesha nosizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo._
stop_confirmation:
🛑 *Idatha Isusiwe & Ukhishiwe*

Ukhishiwe futhi yonke imininingwane yakho nomlando wengxoxo kucishiwe unomphela.

Ukuze uqale kabusha noma nini, thumela igama elithi *START* noma *Sawubona*.
subject_body: Ingabe ufunela bani lesi siqondiso sezempilo? Imithetho yezempilo iyahluka kulowo nalowo:
age_body: Usana lwakho lunezinyanga ezingaki? Iziqondiso zezempilo ziyahluka kakhulu kwabangaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisi-6:
loc_body:
Ukuze sikunikeze izexwayiso ezinembile zesimo sezulu, ukushisa nezibhedlela eziseduze, sicela ubhale igama ledolobha lakho noma uthumele indawo ku-WhatsApp (Location Pin).

Ungase futhi weqe lesi sinyathelo okwamanje.
welcome_body:
Sawubona {userName}! Ngingu-Dayli AI — umsizi wakho wezempilo yomama, izingane nesimo sezulu.

Ungangibuza mayelana:
1. ☀️ Isimo sezulu nezexwayiso zokushisa endaweni yangakini
2. 💧 Ukuphuza amanzi ngokuphepha nokunakekela izinsana
3. 🏥 Amagumbi okubelethela, izibhedlela namakhemisi aseduze
4. 🌡️ Isiqondiso somkhuhlane nezimpawu zokukhulelwa

Ngingakusiza kanjani namuhla?
emergency_banner: 🚨 *Lokhu kudinga ukunakekelwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo esibhedlela ngokushesha*
emergency_lead: Izimpawu ozichazile zingaba yingozi enkulu empilweni masinyane.
emergency_action_112: Shayela i-ambulensi noma uye ngqo egumbini lezimo eziphuthumayo esibhedlela esiseduze.
emergency_action_upright: Gcina usana luhlezi lulungile ukuze umgudu wokuphefumula uhlale uvulekile. Thukulula izingubo eziqinile.
emergency_action_no_fluids: Unganikezi ukudla, ubisi, amanzi noma i-ORS lapho ukuphefumula kunzima ukuvimbela ukungena emaphashini.
emergency_maternal_102: Ezimweni eziphuthumayo zokubeletha, thola i-ambulensi ngokushesha.
fever_guidance:
🌡️ *Ukuphathwa Komkhuhlane*

• *Izinsana ezingaphansi kwezinyanga ezi-3:* Noma yimuphi umkhuhlane uyisimo esiphuthumayo — bonana nodokotela ngalolo suku.
• Sula ngendwangu enamanzi asivivi kuphela. Ungalokothi usebenzise amanzi eziqandisiwe noma utshwala.
• Nikeza uketshezi oluncane njalo.
⚠️ *Angikwazi ukunquma imithamo yemithi.* Sicela uxhumane nodokotela noma usokhemisi.
_Ezimweni eziphuthumayo, funa usizo lwesibhedlela ngokushesha._
heat_hydration_infant:
💧 *Ukuphuzisa Izinsana Nokuphepha Ekushiseni (Umhlahlandlela we-WHO)*

• *Izinsana ezingaphansi kwezinyanga ezi-6:* Ubisi lwebele kuphela noma ifomula. *AKUVUNYELWE NEZE AMANZI AVAMILE* — amanzi ezinganeni ezingaphansi kwezinyanga ezi-6 angadala ubuthi bamanzi (water intoxication) nokuphazamiseka kasawoti emzimbeni.
• Ncelisa kaningi ngesikhathi sokushisa kwasemini.
• Gqokisa usana izingubo ezilula zikakotini.
• Bheka izimpawu zokuphelelwa ngamanzi: ukhakhayi olugobele ngaphakathi, amanabukeni omile (>amahora 6), noma ukungabikho kwezinyembezi lapho lukhala.
disclaimer: _I-Dayli inikeza isiqondiso esivamile, akusona ukuxilongwa kodokotela. Ezimweni eziphuthumayo, funa usizo lwezibhedlela._
